messages:
emma-partnerships: Heads up 1 Inverness (eu-north-2) partner kickoff with Vektor Cloud. They want marketplace SKU + private HSM key flow. Need quotas, entitlement signoff, and a rollout plan. Quick sync? :spiral_calendar:
raghav-cloud: Ok. Do we have initial GPU count and expected QPS for pilot?
viktor-vektor: Pilot numbers: 4 reserved V100-equivalent GPUs, expect burst up to 12 for stress runs. QPS avg 40, spike 120 during load tests. Will need marketplace listing and tenant entitlements.
tom-ops: I'll prep the quota request once you confirm exact SKU name and project. Prefer this format to paste into partner portal:
```
project: redwood-infra
region: eu-north-2
sku: redwood-edge-v100
requested: 12
notes: reserved 4 for pilot, burst to 12 for load tests, partner: Vektor
```
lucy-legal: Legal flag 1 Vektor will handle customer logs via their SI. Need a limited-access SLA + DPA amendment. Please attach data retention window and whether logs contain PII. I can fast-track a 2-party addendum if we get details by EOD tomorrow.
sasha-sre: Rollout suggestion: dev (1 node, 1 GPU), internal canary (2 nodes, 2 GPUs), partner canary (4 GPUs), prod (4 reserved, autoscale to burst 12). Perf tests at each stage. Add smoke checks for kv-cache correctness and token accounting.
marketplace-bot: [marketplace-bot] draft SKU created: https://marketplace.internal/drafts/redwood-edge-vektor-eun2. Please review entitlements section.
emma-partnerships: Nice. Viktor: can you confirm KMS path? They said "partner-HSM" but we need ARN/endpoint + whether it supports EEK (envelope encryption).
viktor-vektor: We're using a customer HSM (Thales Cloud) for production, but pilot will use AWS KMS. We will provide ARNs for the pilot and HSM contact for prod. EEK supported.
raghav-cloud: Good. We need service account and KMS key ARN to configure envelope flow. Also confirm whether the partner will rotate keys monthly or on-demand.
viktor-vektor: Rotation schedule: monthly for pilot, on-demand supported in prod. We'll send ARNs + rotation policy in next email.
tom-ops: Filing quota ticket now. ETA from cloud partner ~48hrs. Tagging high priority due to pilot demo window.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] quota ticket #5012 opened by tom-ops 1 https://ticketing.internal/5012
marketplace-bot: [marketplace-bot] entitlements updated to include: tenant-isolation, private-kms, si-agent-access. Review required: emma-partnerships, ragav-cloud.
sasha-sre: Network ports for SI agent: outbound to `ingest.redwood.ai:443`, inbound TCP 4600 from our ops CIDR. Also need firewall rule for healthcheck port 9090.
lucy-legal: Also confirm whether Vektor will ingest logs containing IP addresses. If so, add IP pseudonymization clause.
eviktor-vektor: We do collect source IP for routing but can pseudonymize for pilot. OK to add clause.
emma-partnerships: Timeline check: partner asks for pilot demo week of June 6. Can we target partner canary by May 30 and full reserved capacity by June 4?
raghav-cloud: May 30 partner canary is tight but possible if quota ticket and KMS ARNs land this week. Ops + SRE need 72h lead to provision and test.
tom-ops: Maintenance window proposed: May 28 01:00-05:00 UTC for node prep and kernel updates. Agree?@sasha-sre
sasha-sre: Works for us. We'll run perf harness May 29 and smoke checks May 30 morning.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] runbook created: https://runbooks.internal/r/vektor-inverness-onboard. Assigning tom-ops, sasha-sre, emma-partnerships.
emma-partnerships: Next steps summary: 1) viktor send KMS ARNs + rotation policy (today) 2) tom file quota (done) 3) lucy draft 2-party DPA and pseudonymization clause (in progress) 4) sasha spin canary and perf harness May 29 5) marketplace team finalize SKU listing by May 24. Ping me with any blockers. :white_check_mark:
marketplace-bot: [marketplace-bot] SKU publish target set to 2024-05-24.
raghav-cloud: I'll standby for ARNs and will queue the envelope key config once received.
viktor-vektor: Sending ARNs now. Expect email with keys + contact. Thanks all.
emma-partnerships: Great, closing thread. Please post status updates here as they happen."
